title: Various Aspects Of Rule Under Tughlaqs
definition: The Tughlaq dynasty (1320–1414 AD) represented the zenith of the Delhi Sultanate's territorial expansion and the subsequent onset of administrative decentralization and systemic crises.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested for its radical administrative experiments, agrarian reforms, and the socio-political impact of Muhammad bin Tughlaq's policies on the Sultanate's stability.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Various Aspects Of Rule Under Tughlaqs.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
